extName.message: MemeBox: Meme Soundboard & Voice Changer for Calls

extDesc.message: Meme soundboard & voice changer for calls: play meme sounds and sound effects into your mic on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Discord.

actionTitle.message: MemeBox: send this tab's sound to your call

join_first.message: Join the call first, then press 😂

err_reload.message: MemeBox was updated. Reload the call tab.

muted_nobody.message: You are muted, so memes are silent too. Unmute and try again.

no_lines.message: No lines yet. Add some in Options.

slot_empty.message: Nothing on Alt+$1 yet. Pick a favourite slot in Options.

ui_hidden.message: MemeBox is hidden. Press Alt+M to show it again.

tab_on.message: 📺 Your other tab's sound is going into the call

tab_bar.message: 📺 Another tab's sound is playing into your mic

st_none.message: You haven't joined a call yet. Join the call, then press 😂

st_suspended.message: Click anywhere on the page once to switch memes on

st_muted.message: You are muted, so memes stay silent until you unmute

fab_tip.message: Click: random meme · hold or right-click: panel · drag to move

btn_mic_test_tip.message: Plays a short ding-dong into your mic. Ask someone in the call if they heard it.

monitor_tip.message: The call always gets the meme through your mic. This only adds a quiet copy on your own speakers.

monitor_on.message: 🎧 You and the call both hear memes

monitor_off.message: 🔇 Only the call hears memes now

monitor_on_tip.message: You hear memes too (click to stop hearing them, the call still hears them)

monitor_off_tip.message: You don't hear memes (click to hear them too, the call hears them either way)

duck_tip.message: Memes get quieter while you are talking

panel_foot.message: Click a line to play it · 😂 random · Alt+1…9 favourites · Alt+0 stop · Alt+M hide

timers_on.message: ⏰ Timed lines are on (while a call is open): $1

empty_star.message: No favourites yet. Tap ☆ on a line.

pp_send.message: 🎙 Send this tab's sound to my call

pp_how1.message: Join your call in another tab (Meet, Zoom web, Teams web or Discord web).

pp_how2.message: In this tab, start the YouTube video or Instagram reel at the funny moment.

pp_how3.message: Click “Send this tab's sound” and everyone in the call hears it through your mic.

pp_how4.message: Click ⏹ when you're done, or use ⏹ in the 😂 panel.

pp_how_note.message: Nothing is downloaded or recorded. The sound is only mixed live into your mic.

pp_no_call.message: Join a call first (in another tab), then come back to the video tab and click here.

pp_this_is_call.message: This is your call tab. Open the YouTube / Instagram tab and click MemeBox there to send its sound. Use 😂 on this page for memes.

pp_sending.message: ✅ This tab's sound is going into your call.

pp_replace.message: Another tab is being sent right now. Sending this one will replace it.

pp_start_video.message: Start the video at the funny part, then:

pp_join_unmute.message: Join the call and unmute first.

pp_cant_capture.message: Chrome won't let this tab be captured: $1

op_sub.message: Your lines, clips, packs and party mode. Everything stays in this browser.

op_say.message: Pronounce as (optional, e.g. Devanagari for Hinglish lines)

op_shortcut_hint.message: Alt+1…3 and Alt+0 work everywhere. Change keys or add Alt+4…9 at

op_no_lines.message: No lines yet. Add one above, or add a pack below.

op_err_clip_missing.message: Clip not found. Add it again.

op_clips_hint.message: Use an audio file or a video (only its sound is kept), a direct file link, or record yourself. Then trim it. A saved clip can be up to 1 MB.

op_video_sites.message: YouTube, Instagram and other video pages are never downloaded. Play them live with the toolbar button → “Send this tab's sound”.

op_too_long.message: Too long for 1 MB. Keep it under about $1 s.

op_err_type.message: Use an audio or video file (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, MP4, WEBM)

op_err_no_audio.message: Couldn't find any sound in that file

op_err_too_big_source.message: That file is too big (max 50 MB before trimming)

op_err_url.message: Paste a full link starting with https://

op_err_video_page.message: That's a video page, not a file. MemeBox never downloads from YouTube, Instagram or other video sites. Open it in a tab and use the toolbar button → “Send this tab's sound”.

op_err_not_file.message: The link must end in .mp3, .mp4, .wav, .ogg or .webm

op_err_blocked.message: $1 doesn't let other sites use its files (it blocks CORS). Download the file and use “Choose a file” instead.

op_err_mic.message: MemeBox needs your OK to use the microphone for recording

op_packs_hint.message: A pack holds lines and their clips. Importing adds to your lines, and lines with the same id are replaced. Files are checked strictly.

op_export_partial.message: Exported $1 lines (clips from older versions were skipped)

op_import_invalid.message: That pack file isn't valid. See the list below.

op_party_hint.message: Off by default. Timers only fire while a call tab is open and your mic is connected.

op_timer_added_off.message: Timer added. Switch on “Play timed lines automatically” to use it.

op_privacy_text.message: Your microphone and tab audio are only mixed inside this browser. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent anywhere. No accounts, servers or analytics.

tab_volume.message: Volume of the tab sound in the call

voice_tip.message: Changes YOUR live voice in the call. Alt+V switches it on and off. "Off" gives your plain voice back instantly.

voice_now_off.message: Voice changer off, your normal voice is back

voice_after_join.message: Saved. It starts when you join the call.

cam_tip.message: Draws the meme text on the video others see from you. Turn your camera off and on to apply. Your own preview may show it mirrored, but others see it the right way.

cam_on.message: Camera captions on. Turn your camera off and on to apply.

cam_off.message: Camera captions off. Turn your camera off and on to apply.

op_save_wav_tip.message: Save as an audio file (WAV) to share anywhere

op_share_wa_tip.message: Opens WhatsApp with the text filled in. You choose the chat and press send.

pro_only.message: This is a MemeBox Pro feature.

ob_sub.message: Three steps and you're the funniest person in the call.

ob_s1.message: Join your call in the browser

ob_s1_text.message: Google Meet, Zoom (web), Microsoft Teams (web) or Discord (web). The 😂 button appears in the corner. If the call was already open, reload it once.

ob_s2_text.message: It goes into your microphone, so everyone in the call hears it. They don't need MemeBox. When you're muted, memes are silent too.

ob_s3_text.message: Pick any line, search, change your voice (Alt+V), or play favourites with Alt+1 to Alt+9. To play a YouTube video into the call, click the MemeBox icon in the toolbar on that tab.

ob_mic_hint.message: Check that your microphone works. The sound stays on this page. Nothing is recorded.

ob_mic_ok.message: ✅ We hear you. Your mic works.

ob_mic_blocked.message: The microphone is blocked. Click the camera/mic icon in the address bar and allow it.

ob_mic_none.message: No microphone found. Plug one in and try again.

ob_done.message: You're ready. Your lines, clips and packs are in Settings.

pp_reload_tab.message: This call tab was open before MemeBox was installed or updated. Reload it (F5), then join the call again.

op_picture_hint.message: Flashes on your screen while the line plays, and on your camera if "Caption on my camera" is on. Use your own pictures, or others' only with their OK.

op_err_picture.message: That file isn't a picture MemeBox can use. Try PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF.

op_err_picture_big.message: That picture is too big. Try a smaller one (up to 20 MB).

pro_pictures.message: You have used your $1 picture meme(s). Get more with MemeBox Pro or a picture pack (Options → MemeBox Pro).

op_bulk_hint.message: Import many files: each one becomes a clip (cut to fit 1 MB) named after its file, in the "clips" category.

op_pro_off.message: Pro is switched off right now, so every feature is free for everyone.

op_pro_active.message: ✅ MemeBox Pro is active in this browser.

op_pro_free.message: Free plan: up to $1 picture meme(s), 10 clips, the General and College packs.

op_license_offline.message: Couldn't reach the MemeBox site. Check your internet and try again.

op_license_stale.message: The key $1 couldn't be checked for a long time. Go online so MemeBox can check it again.
